blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala couldn’t complete her gold medal quest in the Asian Games 2026 after getting upset by China’s Wang Xiyu, 3-6, 6-3, 6-2, in the semifinals on Thursday at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Nagoya City. Eala’s hot 5-0 start in the first set wasn’t enough, with Wang, ranked No.85 in the world, remaining unfazed against the crowd favorite and top-ranked player of the tournament. Wang fell short of a comeback in the first set, but cruised to a 5-1 lead in the second before Eala won two […]...
